See the actual course plan first.

Your proposed plan lists where to take each course, what it counts toward, and the credits applied to the degree. You can add courses you already finished and compare other degree options using the same collection.

Build my GCU business plan
How GCU’s transfer limits affect this plan

GCU permits up to 90 total undergraduate transfer credits, including a shared maximum of 30 credits from alternative sources. The current course plan proposes 26 outside credits based on the receiving matches we have reviewed. The 90-credit ceiling is separate from the amount mapped in this route.

Actual source credits are preserved. A three-credit course that covers a four-credit course’s content still counts as three credits; any remaining degree-credit balance is shown as real coursework. The plan preserves GCU’s residency, upper-level and writing requirements.

Campus tuition is billed by semester load. Removing a course does not automatically remove a semester or reduce its tuition; your schedule and financial aid determine the personal comparison.
